notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Marvin using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
